entries.2b7599de2c394df9: Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,441,039 thousand (up 8.1% year on year), broken down as: mail-order business ¥1,201,461 thousand, wholesale business ¥612,339 thousand, retail business ¥483,766 thousand and consulting business ¥143,835 thousand.

entries.4b81e124a07cc8df: For the fiscal year ended September 2025, the company posted an operating loss of ¥165,319 thousand (operating loss of ¥126,174 thousand in the previous year's same period). The mail-order business secured segment profit of ¥183,867 thousand and the wholesale business ¥182,951 thousand, while the retail business recorded a segment loss of ¥28,145 thousand and the consulting business a segment loss of ¥29,945 thousand, reflecting, among other things, goodwill amortization of ¥65,368 thousand from a business acquisition and outsourcing expenses of ¥79,016 thousand incurred in advance.
entries.5cf279e7c23e80be: Through the holding company and three consolidated subsidiaries (HACCP Japan Co., Ltd., iiy Co., Ltd., and Fantastic Four No. 1 LLC), the company operates a mail-order, wholesale and retail business across three sales channels, and a consulting business that sells rights to solar power generation facilities and grid-connected storage battery facilities. Of net sales of ¥2,441,039 thousand for the fiscal year ended September 2025, the mail-order business was the largest at ¥1,201,461 thousand, followed by the wholesale business at ¥612,339 thousand, the retail business at ¥483,766 thousand and the consulting business at ¥143,835 thousand.
